Because the ferrous stamp is verified against the thread nonce, the copper audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 28 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. A 391 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
